ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ("Agreement") dated as of May 25, 2016,is made by and between 546 LAFAYETTE AVENUE MANAGEMENT, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at 571 West 183 Street, New York, New York 10033 (the “Owner") and 546 LAFEYETTE LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at 293 Nostrand Avenue, Brooklyn, NewYork 11216 ("Developer"). WITNESSETHTHAT: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land (Owner's Land") in the City of New York, and the buildings and improvements thereon ("Owner's Building"), located at 546 Lafayette Avenue,Brooklyn,New York,known as Block 1788, Lot 32 on the Tax Map and as more particularly described in Schedule “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the Land, together with the Building being herein called, collectively, the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land adjacent·to the Owner Parcel ("Developer's Land") in the City of New York, and the buildings and improvements thereon ("Developer's Existing Building"), located at 548 Lafayette Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, known as Block 1788, Lot 132 on the Tax Map and as more particularly described in Schedule "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (Developer's Land, together with Developer's Existing Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer proposes to construct a new building or buildings, or additions to the buildings and improvements currently located in whole or in part on all or any part or parts of Developer's Land and/or other properties that may hereafter be added to such lots, as provided in this Agreement, which may be now or hereinafter owned or leased by a and said new building(s) and improvements and any related improvements, additions thereto and replacements thereof being herein collectively called *Developer's New Building"); WHEREAS,the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel heretofore constituted a single tax lot (the “Single Tax Lot") and a single “zoning lot", and, while the Single Tax Lot has been subdivided intoTax Lots 32 and132,it continues to constitute a single zoning lot; WHEREAS, it is contemplated that Developer's New Building will contain more floor area ("Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution (the “Zoning Resolution") of the City of New York, effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time, than is now available for use in respect of the Developer Parcel or, if applicable, Developer's Development Site,under the “floor area ratio” limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution, with the result that Developer desires to utilize, or permit the utilization of, theprocedures available under the Zoning Resolution to make available to a DeveloperParty for such purpose the unused Floor Area attributable to the Owner Parcel).
